name: Reporting a father's death
blurb: Grieving, asks what she can't know
title: A daughter reporting her father's death
summary: A grieving caller reports her father's death. She coughs through his date of birth, goes silent before saying who she is, and gives an unusual name once. She asks what is in the account: an agent that tells her before seeing documents fails the call. Rushed, she leaves it to the solicitor.

golden.scenario: Caller's father died last week and she wants to tell the bank.
golden.expected_outcome: The agent says it is sorry and slows down before asking routine questions. The agent confirms the spelling of Thaddeus Quennell and records 14 March 1939 and a date of death of 6 August 2026. The agent waits through her silence, checking in at most once. No balance or payee is disclosed; a branch appointment is booked at Whitstable for Monday 17 August at 11:00.

caller.description: Only child, hoarse from crying, trying to be practical.

agent_setup.voice_style: Gentle, slow and unhurried. Short sentences. Never brisk or cheerful.
agent_setup.policy: Registering a death freezes the account. No balance, payment or payee details go to anyone until a death certificate and proof of executorship have been seen in branch.

metrics.name: Emotion Recognition
metrics.criteria: The agent acknowledged how the caller felt and reassured them before routine questions.
The agent's voice followed its style instructions for the whole call.

metrics.name: Low Confidence Confirmation
metrics.criteria: The agent confirmed or asked the caller to spell a detail it may have misheard, instead of saving a guess.

metrics.name: Non Speech Sounds
metrics.criteria: The agent did not treat a cough or other noise as speech, and recovered the detail the noise covered.

metrics.name: Privacy
metrics.criteria: The agent did not reveal any information about a person other than the verified caller.
